app_name: AuraFinance - AI Personal Finance Operating System
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS TACTICAL HYBRID

typography.font_files_js_note: Ensure Google Fonts link for Outfit, Inter, JetBrains Mono is in index.html or imported in index.css

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: High Density Tactical Grid (Mode B for Dashboards) + Bento asymmetric sections for AI Insights
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-2xl for hero widgets, rounded-full for badges and action pills

ai_financial_brain.vibe: Command center with instant actionable financial summaries
ai_financial_brain.style: Subtle emerald glow backdrop, live badge indicator, clean narrative bullet cards with risk labels

signature_next_500_eur_advisor.interaction: Slider + custom EUR input field with preset chips (€100, €500, €1,000, €5,000). On click/type -> animated split distribution with logic tags (Risk level, Expected outcome, Tax efficiency, Emergency reserve impact).

smart_asset_allocator.components: Interactive Recharts pie/donut breakdown across Stocks/ETFs, Index Funds, Precious Metals, Real Estate, Crypto, Cash with instant reasoning hover details & rebalancing suggestions.

wealth_predictor.components: Interactive age & inflation adjusted projection chart with 3 scenario toggles (Conservative, Balanced, High Growth), input sliders for monthly contributions, horizon years, and target goal age.

expense_detector.components: Subscription creep detector badges, unusual transaction flag list with filter tags, recurring billing calendar preview, manual transaction editor.

opportunity_scanner.components: Real-time mock/live fetch for BTC, ETH, Gold, Silver, S&P500 EUR prices, volatility alerts, pros/cons breakdown cards for emerging opportunities.

trust_and_safety.banner: Prominent sticky or persistent 'Read-Only & Educational Disclaimer' bar with zero-execution guarantee badge.
trust_and_safety.gdpr: One-click JSON Data Export and Instant Account Data Delete in Settings.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and key financial metric displays MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case role-based format (e.g. data-testid="next-amount-input", data-testid="net-worth-display", data-testid="google-login-button", data-testid="gdpr-export-button")

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as specified in the project stack.
Implement Google Sign-In button simulation alongside standard Email/Password authentication tab.
Ensure currency formatting defaults to EUR (€) with locale formatting (e.g., €12,450.00).
Provide interactive sample data editing modal or drawer so users can tweak income, debts, and assets dynamically.
Add persistent banner: 'Read-Only Mode — Educational & Analytics Tool Only. Not Regulated Financial Advice.'
Implement Sonner toasts for all user interactions (e.g. data export, sample data reset, input updates).
Avoid generic AI slop: use clean Swiss card structures with precise 1px borders, subtle hover elevations, crisp typography, and high contrast.
